# Prostuti (প্রস্তুতি)
# Bangladesh Government Job Exam Preparation Platform
# https://prostutii.com

## About
Prostuti is Bangladesh's leading free online platform for government job exam preparation.
It provides 16,000+ MCQ questions for Primary Teacher (প্রাথমিক শিক্ষক নিয়োগ), BCS Preliminary, Bank Jobs, and NTRCA exams.

## Features
- Free online mock tests (80 marks, 80 minutes — matching real exam format)
- Subject-based quizzes: Bangla, English, Math, General Knowledge
- Mistake tracker with revision exam capability
- Radar chart analytics for performance analysis
- National leaderboard with district and institution filters
- PDF download of results with explanations
- Daily streak and XP gamification system
- Google OAuth single-click login

## Target Users
Job seekers in Bangladesh preparing for:
- প্রাথমিক শিক্ষক নিয়োগ (Primary Teacher Recruitment)
- BCS Preliminary Examination (Bangladesh Civil Service)
- Bank Job Examinations
- NTRCA Teacher Registration
- General government job MCQ exams

## Language
Primary language: Bengali (বাংলা)
Secondary language: English

Website: https://prostutii.com

Questions: 16,000+
Subjects: 4 (Bangla, English, Math, General Knowledge)
